contents.name: Identifier
contents.description: The address of the Modbus datum to be read, as <TABLE>:<0-based address>. Table prefixes: CO (coils), DI (discrete inputs), IR (input registers), HR (holding registers). E.g. "HR:100" reads holding register 100 (traditional number 40101), "IR:30" input register 30 (30031), "CO:5" coil 5, "DI:2" discrete input 2. Must be unique across the streams of a source.

contents.name: Datatype

enumValues.name: BOOL
enumValues.description: Single bit read from a coil or discrete input.
enumValues.comment: Maps to System.Boolean. Only valid for CO and DI addresses.

enumValues.name: INT16
enumValues.comment: Maps to System.Int16. Occupies 1 register. Only valid for IR and HR addresses.

enumValues.name: UINT16
enumValues.comment: Maps to System.UInt16. Occupies 1 register. Only valid for IR and HR addresses.

enumValues.name: INT32
enumValues.description: Signed 32-bit integer in two consecutive registers.
enumValues.comment: Maps to System.Int32. Occupies 2 registers. Only valid for IR and HR addresses.

enumValues.name: UINT32
enumValues.description: Unsigned 32-bit integer in two consecutive registers.
enumValues.comment: Maps to System.UInt32. Occupies 2 registers. Only valid for IR and HR addresses.

enumValues.name: INT64
enumValues.description: Signed 64-bit integer in four consecutive registers.
enumValues.comment: Maps to System.Int64. Occupies 4 registers. Only valid for IR and HR addresses.

enumValues.name: UINT64
enumValues.description: Unsigned 64-bit integer in four consecutive registers.
enumValues.comment: Maps to System.UInt64. Occupies 4 registers. Only valid for IR and HR addresses.

enumValues.name: FLOAT32
enumValues.description: IEEE 754 single-precision value in two consecutive registers.
enumValues.comment: Maps to System.Single. Occupies 2 registers. Only valid for IR and HR addresses.

enumValues.name: FLOAT64
enumValues.description: IEEE 754 double-precision value in four consecutive registers.
enumValues.comment: Maps to System.Double. Occupies 4 registers. Only valid for IR and HR addresses.

contents.description: The wire type of the Modbus datum (e.g. "FLOAT32"). Modbus registers are raw 16-bit words, so the type cannot be discovered from the device. BOOL is only valid for CO/DI addresses; all other types only for IR/HR addresses.

contents.name: ByteOrder

enumValues.name: BIG_ENDIAN
enumValues.description: Most significant register/byte first (the Modbus specification default, also called ABCD).

enumValues.name: LITTLE_ENDIAN
enumValues.description: Least significant register/byte first (DCBA), used by some vendors for multi-register values.

contents.description: Byte/register order used to decode values spanning multiple registers (e.g. "BIG_ENDIAN"). Defaults to BIG_ENDIAN (Modbus specification conformant) when not set. Irrelevant for BOOL/INT16/UINT16.

contents.name: ReadCycleInterval
contents.description: Poll interval in seconds for this stream (e.g. 10). When not set, defaults to the source's DefaultReadCycleInterval.
